newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: South African captain Hansie Cronje won the toss and chose to bat first against India in the re-played day/night final of the triangular series at Kingsmead on Thursday.
South Africa: Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Rudi Bryson, Allan Donald.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Salil Ankola, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad.
